posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
Infernal Relics is now available for all platforms and so the six new variants are now unlockable in-game. You can coordinate on the community forums with other players to discover the variant unlocks! Plus, the first person to unlock a variant and send us the screenshot via Twitter, Facebook, or Google+ will earn an exclusive spot on the Hall of Fame. 
 
http://sentinelsdigital.com/halloffame.html 
 
Here are the new variants you'll be hunting for: 
  • Redeemer Fanatic 
  • Ra: Horus of Two Horizons 
  • Dark Visionary 
  • Dark Watch NightMist 
  • Skinwalker GloomWeaver 
  • Spite: Agent of Gloom

 

On Steam & Android you'll need the 1.4.2 update and on iOS you'll need the 1.4 update, all available today.

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked: Also - there is a bug in the unlock condition for Spite: Agent of Gloom on the iOS version. It is easier than it is supposed to be. We'll clarify with more details when appropriate.
